properties.description: The table-driven test over every served typed constructor (every add_* tool, plan_epoch, record_finding) and every optional property its node type declares: left out keeps, null unsets and is named under `unset`, a null on a required field is refused and writes nothing, and the node stays revisable. Membership is read off the served surface, so a new constructor joins when it is served. A module of the MCP crate's in_memory test program.
properties.name: a_null_unsets_at_every_typed_constructor.rs
